DIAGNOSIS READY: Newborn Jaundice (Hyperbilirubinemia)

The progression of jaundice from the face to the trunk and the presence of scleral icterus indicate significant hyperbilirubinemia, which requires immediate confirmation of bilirubin levels and an ultrasound to rule out biliary obstruction or other pathology.
